title: Rocket Report: Rocket Lab shows off its flexibility; Blue Origin's two-pad plan
summary: Rocket launch capacity faces unprecedented constraints, prompting companies like Rocket Lab and Blue Origin to demonstrate operational flexibility. The report explores how these organizations are adapting their launch strategies to meet growing demand.
content: "We’ve never seen launch capacity so constrained."

zh.title: 火箭报告：Rocket Lab展示灵活性；Blue Origin推出双发射台计划
zh.summary: 火箭发射能力面临前所未有的限制，促使Rocket Lab和Blue Origin等公司展示运营灵活性。该报告探讨了这些组织如何调整发射策略以满足不断增长的需求。

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra review: The ultra foldable with an ultra price
summary: Samsung's latest foldable smartphone maintains the company's hardware excellence while keeping design changes minimal, though the premium pricing reflects its ultra-positioning. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra demonstrates that meaningful improvements aren't always necessary when the foundation is strong.
content: Samsung didn't have to change much this year because its hardware is just that good.

zh.title: 三星Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra评测：超级折叠机，超级价格
zh.summary: 三星最新折叠智能手机保持了公司的硬件优势，同时最小化设计变化，但高溢价反映了其超级定位。Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra证明，当基础坚实时，有意义的改进并不总是必要的。

title: Uber and Pony.ai plan to bring 2,000 robotaxis to Europe
summary: Uber and autonomous vehicle partner Pony.ai are expanding their robotaxi service across Europe, moving beyond their initial Zagreb deployment to four additional cities. The expansion marks a significant step in bringing autonomous vehicle services to European consumers.
content: The partnership is expanding beyond the initial market of Zagreb, Croatia to four additional European cities.

zh.title: Uber与Pony.ai计划在欧洲部署2000辆机器人出租车
zh.summary: Uber与自动驾驶合作伙伴Pony.ai正在扩展其无人出租车服务至欧洲，超越最初的萨格勒布部署，进入四个额外城市。此次扩展标志着向欧洲消费者提供自动驾驶服务的重要步骤。

title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
summary: Apple has developed a custom large language model for the Chinese market in partnership with Alibaba, a rare collaboration that signals a shift in the company's strategy for controlling its Chinese operations. The partnership demonstrates how global tech companies are adapting to competitive pressures and geopolitical dynamics in China.
content:
Apple has reportedly trained a custom AI model for the China market alongside domestic tech giant Alibaba, a rare cross-border partnership that cuts across growing tensions between Beijing and Washington.
The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company's support, Reuters reports, citing three unnamed people familiar with the matter.

zh.title: 苹果与阿里巴巴合作为中国开发定制AI模型
zh.summary: 苹果与阿里巴巴合作为中国市场开发了一款定制大语言模型,这是一次罕见的合作,表明苹果的中国运营战略发生了转变。这次合作展示了全球科技公司如何应对中国市场的竞争压力和地缘政治挑战。

title: Help build a monument to that ‘sad little bitch’ Elon Musk
summary: Cards Against Humanity is launching a crowdfunded campaign to build a provocative monument near SpaceX's Starbase in Texas, continuing the company's tradition of high-profile stunts. The project echoes the company's 2017 purchase of land to obstruct Trump's border wall plans.
content:
“Build the perfect monument to force a moment of introspection upon the world’s richest, ugliest little bitch.” | Image: Brendan SMIALOWSKI / AFP via Getty Images	

Cards Against Humanity is gearing up to build "something that will annoy Elon Musk," and it's crowdfunding the project with its usual flavor of vulgarity. The company behind the card game announced plans to build "a grand monument" to Musk on the parcel of land it owns near Starbase, Texas, with the aim to "make him wonder, for a brief moment, 'Wait, am I a sad little bitch with no friends?'"

zh.title: 众筹建造讽刺埃隆·马斯克的纪念碑
zh.summary: 《反人类卡牌》公司正启动众筹活动,在德克萨斯州SpaceX星舰基地附近建造一座充满讽刺的纪念碑,延续其一贯的高调噱头传统。该项目呼应了该公司2017年购买土地以阻止特朗普边境墙计划的行动。

title: Organic-looking brake assemblies debut on new Czinger 21C Spyder
summary: Czinger has unveiled advanced brake assemblies for its 21C Spyder supercar, utilizing topological optimization and additive manufacturing to achieve organic-looking designs. The innovation demonstrates how 3D printing technology enables new approaches to automotive component engineering.
content: Czinger used topological design and additive manufacturing to make the brakes.

zh.title: Czinger 21C Spyder超级跑车推出有机外观制动组件
zh.summary: Czinger为其21C Spyder超级跑车推出了采用拓扑优化和增材制造技术的先进制动组件,实现了有机外观设计。这一创新展示了3D打印技术如何为汽车零部件工程开启了新的设计方向。

title: Trump declares 100 percent tariffs on many drones and all aircraft parts
summary: Trump has imposed 100% tariffs on various drone and aircraft parts imports including thermal camera drones, drones over 25kg, and unmanned aircraft parts. This protectionist measure targets both new bans and existing imports, aiming to significantly increase costs on foreign drone and aircraft component imports. The action reflects broader Trump administration policies restricting foreign technology access to the US market.
content:
The United States has already banned future foreign drones from entering the United States unless their companies kiss the ring - as well as routers, robots, and Roombas. Now, President Donald Trump is targeting existing drone imports and parts, too. He's going to try to make them cost a lot more.
In a presidential action, he's declared a whopping 100 percent tariff on imports of drones with thermal cameras, drones weighing over 25kg (57 pounds), and any kind of part for any kind of unmanned aircraft weighing over 25kg - you can read the full list here. zh.title: 特朗普宣布对许多无人机和所有飞机零件征收100%关税
zh.summary: 特朗普对包括热像仪无人机、25公斤以上无人机和无人航空器零件在内的各种无人机和飞机零件进口征收100%关税。这项保护性措施既针对新禁令，也针对现有进口，旨在大幅增加外国无人机和飞机组件进口的成本。该行动反映了特朗普政府更广泛的政策，即限制外国技术进入美国市场。
